g.aria-label: box start: DIY BC-250 AI NODE BUILD
box source: SOURCE + INSPECT — board / connectors / heatsink / storage / physical condition
g.text: SOURCE + INSPECT — board / connectors / heatsink / storage / physical condition

g.aria-label: box mount: MOUNT — simple safe frame / protect underside / define airflow path
g.text: MOUNT — simple safe frame / protect underside / define airflow path

g.aria-label: box power: POWER — known-good PSU / verify PCIe power / avoid questionable adapters
g.text: POWER — known-good PSU / verify PCIe power / avoid questionable adapters

g.aria-label: box cool: COOLING FIRST — pressure fans / ducting / GDDR6-VRM attention / visible sensors
g.text: COOLING FIRST — pressure fans / ducting / GDDR6-VRM attention / visible sensors

g.aria-label: box boot: BOOT — modern Linux + SSH + management Ethernet + Vulkan check
g.text: BOOT — modern Linux + SSH + management Ethernet + Vulkan check

g.aria-label: box test: STOCK QUALIFICATION — stress / memory / Vulkan / thermal validation
g.text: STOCK QUALIFICATION — stress / memory / Vulkan / thermal validation

g.aria-label: box fix: IF UNSTABLE — repair cooling / power / storage / firmware / board issue, then repeat stock validation
g.text: IF UNSTABLE — repair cooling / power / storage / firmware / board issue, then repeat

g.aria-label: box baseline: IF STABLE — capture power / clocks / temps / Vulkan-visible memory / inference baseline
g.text: IF STABLE — capture power / clocks / temps / Vulkan-visible memory / inference baseline

g.aria-label: box memory: TUNE — TTM/GTT + cooling-efficiency profile; verify repeatable gain
g.text: TUNE — TTM/GTT + cooling-efficiency profile; verify repeatable gain

g.aria-label: box llm: LLM — install llama.cpp or Ollama; start small; step upward in model size and context
g.text: LLM — install llama.cpp or Ollama; start small; step upward in model size and context

g.aria-label: box unlock: OPTIONAL — qualify 40-CU / 8-core path only now; maintain rollback and repeat correctness tests
g.text: OPTIONAL — qualify 40-CU / 8-core path only now; maintain rollback and repeat

g.aria-label: box serve: SERVE — LAN-only API + optional Open WebUI + firewall + process supervision
g.text: SERVE — LAN-only API + optional Open WebUI + firewall + process supervision

g.aria-label: box second: EXPAND — add board #2 only after node #1 is boring and reliable
g.text: EXPAND — add board #2 only after node #1 is boring and reliable

g.aria-label: box done: RESULT — reproducible AI appliance with measured baseline and rollback path
g.text: RESULT — reproducible AI appliance with measured baseline and rollback path
